visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static top-down view of three packaged skincare products—a lip balm, a facial mask box, and a hand cream—arranged on a white surface decorated with white cotton flowers. Large red and white text overlays introduce the theme as "Three Hokkaido Beauty Selections" for dry skin. (2) A pair of hands with manicured nails enters the frame to pick up and display a brown box of OV9 moisturizing facial masks. The box is turned to show the back label with Japanese text. The scene then cuts to three individual mask packets laid out, with descriptive subtitles appearing at the bottom. (3) The second product, Coroku "White Snow" lip balm, is introduced in its white and silver packaging. The hands remove the balm from the box, uncapping the white tube to reveal the solid balm. The balm is then swiped across the person's inner forearm to demonstrate its smooth, moisturizing texture. (4) The final product is a silver tube of Mentholatum North Moist hand cream. The person squeezes a pea-sized amount of thick white cream onto the back of their hand. They use their fingers to spread the cream evenly, while text overlays highlight its effectiveness in sub-zero temperatures. (5) A final montage shows all featured products grouped together. The scene ends with a pink circular logo for "japanuts.com" appearing in the center, surrounded by social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, alongside a call-to-action to like and share the video.
